info.name: Master Operation RBAC - Full API Test
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing all API endpoints with RBAC scenarios.

**How to use:**
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Create an Environment with the variables listed in the README.
3. Run the 'Auth' folder first to populate tokens.
4. Run other folders.

**Test accounts:**
- admin@company.vn / Admin@123
- manager@company.vn / Manager@123
- employee@company.vn / Employee@123

item.name: 02 — Users
item.description: User management endpoints. Admin can manage all. Manager can manage same department. Employee is restricted.

item.name: 03 — Leaves
item.description: Leave request management. Employee can create. Manager can review same department.

item.name: 04 — Tasks
item.description: Task management. Employee can read. Manager can create/assign.

item.name: 05 — Attendance
item.description: Attendance tracking. Employee can checkin/checkout. Manager can view heatmap.

item.name: 06 — Roles & Permissions
item.description: Role and permission management. Admin only.

item.name: 07 — Notifications
item.description: Notification management. Users can only access their own notifications.

item.name: 08 — Leave Balances
item.description: Leave balance management. Users can view their own. Admin can view and update any user's.

item.name: 09 — Audit Logs
item.description: Audit log viewing. Admin only (placeholder currently allows all).

exec: pm.test('Status 403 (or 200 if placeholder)', () => { const code = pm.response.code; pm.expect(code).to.be.oneOf([200,403]); });

item.name: 10 — Health
item.description: Health check endpoint. No authentication required.
